name: MonarchInsightStrip
title: InsightStrip
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow, androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column, androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxWithConstraints, with MonarchCard, MonarchBadge, MonarchCollapsible, MonarchButton and MonarchBanner
summary: A row of insight cards for the top of a dashboard, each showing whether a fixed rule or a model raised it, sorted most severe first.
whenToUse: At the top of a dashboard or a record, for a few findings that need attention: expiring domains, failed backups, a renewal at risk.
whenNotToUse: For one message about the whole screen use MonarchBanner. For a list of records use a list or a table.
api: @Composable fun MonarchInsightStrip(insights: List<MonarchInsight>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, layout: MonarchInsightStripLayout = MonarchInsightStripLayout.Scroll, loading: Boolean = false, errorText: String? = null, limit: Int? = null, sortBySeverity: Boolean = true, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchInsightStripLabels = MonarchInsightStripLabels())

class MonarchInsight(id: String, title: String, why: String, origin: MonarchInsightOrigin, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info, evidence: String? = null, actionLabel: String? = null, onAction: (() -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchInsightStripLayout { Scroll, Stack, Grid }

class MonarchInsightStripLabels(showMore: ((Int) -> String)? = null, showLess: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, retry: String? = null, dismiss: String? = null, evidence: String? = null, ruleOrigin: String? = null, aiOrigin: String? = null, toneLabel: ((MonarchTone) -> String)? = null)

options.name: insights
options.description: The insights: id, title, reason, origin, tone, and optionally evidence and one action.

options.name: layout
options.description: Scroll: one sideways row. Stack: one column. Grid: one to three columns by width.

options.name: errorText
options.description: Replaces the insights with this failure in a danger banner.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many, with "Show N more" for the rest. Zero or less is ignored.

options.name: sortBySeverity
options.description: Orders critical, warning, info, a note, positive; the given order is kept within a tone.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds "Try again" to the error banner.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Adds a dismiss button to every insight; called with its id. The app removes it.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the tone words.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three placeholder cards in the muted background color, one TalkBack element named "Loading insights".

states.name: error
states.description: A danger banner with the message and "Try again" when onRetry is given.

states.name: empty
states.description: "Nothing needs attention right now." in the muted text color.

states.name: limited
states.description: Only the first insights, with "Show N more"; then "Show fewer".

appearance: Each insight is a MonarchCard with a subtle badge in its tone, an outline badge for its origin, the title in the strong body style and the reason in the muted text color. Placeholders use the muted background. Colors come from the roles of the components used, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web strip is built from AiInsightCallout and an EmptyState, InlineErrorRetry and Skeleton, which Android does not have yet; it draws its cards from MonarchCard and MonarchBadge, as iOS does. Severity is MonarchTone (Danger for critical, Success for positive), with Neutral offered as a note. Evidence is a String in a MonarchCollapsible, not arbitrary content. The dismiss button is a text button, "Dismiss", because Monarch bundles no close icon. The default layout is the scrolling row, as on iOS. Moving TalkBack focus to the next insight after a dismissal, which the web does, is not implemented. The web empty={null} has no counterpart: leave the strip out instead. The web heading level has no counterpart: the title is a heading. The badge words (Note, Info, Positive, Warning, Critical) differ from the shared tone names on purpose: they are the visible severity vocabulary of the web AiInsightCallout (info, warning, critical, positive), shown as text on the badge, not only spoken, so they follow the web copy. The monarch_insightstrip_tone_* keys are not deprecated.
accessibility: Each insight is one TalkBack element read as its tone word, its origin, its title and its reason, so neither the tone nor the origin depends on color.
The evidence section, the action and the dismiss button are separate elements with 48dp touch targets.
The loading placeholder is one element named "Loading insights".
The error banner is a polite live region.
Text wraps inside the cards at every font size.
edgeCases: In the scrolling row every card is 85% of the width, at most 320dp, so cards in one row can differ in height.
A limit of zero or less is ignored.
An insight with an actionLabel but no onAction shows no button.
After a dismissal TalkBack focus is left to the system.
In the grid, cards in one row can differ in height.

examples.title: Dashboard insights with limit and dismiss
examples.webExample: Dashboard insights with limit and dismiss
examples.template:
MonarchInsightStrip(
    insights = insights,
    title = {{title}},
    layout = MonarchInsightStripLayout.Grid,
    limit = {{max}},
    onDismiss = { dismissed = dismissed + it },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
var dismissed by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf<String>()) }
val insights = listOf(
    MonarchInsight(
        id = {{insights.0.id}},
        title = {{insights.0.title}},
        why = {{insights.0.why}},
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.{{insights.0.origin|pascal}},
        tone = {{insights.0.tone|tone}},
        evidence = listOf({{insights.0.evidence.0}}, {{insights.0.evidence.1}}, {{insights.0.evidence.2}}).joinToString("\n"),
        actionLabel = {{insights.0.action}},
        onAction = {},
    ),
    MonarchInsight(
        id = {{insights.1.id}},
        title = {{insights.1.title}},
        why = {{insights.1.why}},
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.{{insights.1.origin|pascal}},
        tone = {{insights.1.tone|tone}},
    ),
    MonarchInsight(
        id = {{insights.2.id}},
        title = {{insights.2.title}},
        why = {{insights.2.why}},
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.{{insights.2.origin|pascal}},
        tone = {{insights.2.tone|tone}},
    ),
    MonarchInsight(
        id = {{insights.3.id}},
        title = {{insights.3.title}},
        why = {{insights.3.why}},
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.{{insights.3.origin|pascal}},
        tone = {{insights.3.tone|tone}},
    ),
).filterNot { it.id in dismissed }
examples.setup:
var dismissed by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf<String>()) }
val insights = listOf(
    MonarchInsight(
        id = "expiring",
        title = "3 items expire within 30 days",
        why = "Their end dates fall before 7 December and none has a renewal recorded.",
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.Rule,
        tone = MonarchTone.Danger,
        evidence = listOf("Item A: 12 November", "Item B: 20 November", "Item C: 4 December").joinToString("\n"),
        actionLabel = "Review renewals",
        onAction = {},
    ),
    MonarchInsight(
        id = "usage",
        title = "Weekly use is falling",
        why = "Active people fell from 48 to 29 over the last 30 days.",
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.Ai,
        tone = MonarchTone.Warning,
    ),
    MonarchInsight(
        id = "deadline",
        title = "Next deadline in 12 days",
        why = "A response is due on 19 November.",
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.Rule,
        tone = MonarchTone.Info,
    ),
    MonarchInsight(
        id = "target",
        title = "Quarterly target reached",
        why = "Bookings passed the target set for this quarter.",
        origin = MonarchInsightOrigin.Rule,
        tone = MonarchTone.Success,
    ),
).filterNot { it.id in dismissed }
